objective: Compare the frozen P4-style latched entry veto with one preregistered research-only recovery/cooldown challenger while keeping strategies, folds, costs, quantity, market data, and execution semantics unchanged.

arms.entry_policy: Use the accepted P10 _RiskTracker semantics: once any P4 session-loss, drawdown, or consecutive-loss circuit threshold activates the kill switch, new entries remain blocked for the rest of the OOS fold. Risk-reducing exits remain allowed.

Use the same frozen P4 numeric entry envelope. Drawdown breach is a hard latch through fold end. Session-loss breach blocks new entries only through the breached UTC session and clears at the first later UTC session if no hard drawdown latch exists. Consecutive-loss breach starts a fixed 24 subsequent eligible-primary-decision cooldown. After that cooldown, if flat, outside a session-loss block, and below the drawdown hard limit, only the research entry-eligibility loss-streak counter resets to zero; the observed historical streak is retained in telemetry. Risk-reducing exits remain allowed.

interpretation: HSL-002 is comparative research only. Qualification means only that the cooldown challenger merits later independent HSL study; it cannot alter P4/P10, upgrade P10 evidence, unlock P11, or authorize live trading.
